title: Taser victim a drug user
article: A man who died in police custody after being shot three times by a Taser had drug problems but was "not a monster," his tearful fiancee told an inquest Wednesday.

"That man was my life," Cathy Colborne said as a photo of a smiling Peter Lamonday was projected onto a screen before jurors. "I love him very much." Colborne wiped away tears and buried her face in her hands after lawyer Ron Ellis asked that the picture be shown.
"What does this picture mean to you?" he asked.
"It means everything to me," replied Colborne, who was to have married Lamonday last June.
An autopsy determined Lamonday died May 14, 2004, of cocaine- induced excited delirium, a state in which a person can feel no pain and exhibit incredible strength.
